status: Landscape review complete; fresh portrait review pending on the same frozen source. No runtime, build, handbook or score changes between reviewers.

originalScores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 10 exceptional across observed scope. Subjective ratings of observed emulated mobile interaction, not grades derived from wins, accuracy or unassessed content.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent playable recovery/combat/uplink loop with helpful assistance and atmospheric visuals; cover ambiguity, offscreen threat orientation and dense small HUD reduce confidence.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE and FIRE drag, swipe turn, AIM and DASH all responded visibly. Assisted tap aim helped. DASH evasion success and continuous burst rearming comfort remain unestablished.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery progression, timed coils and deck defense provided understandable variation and pressure. Route completion was heavily assisted, so exploration and sustained manual combat enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong rain-soaked industrial atmosphere, cyan highlights and consistent menu/result styling. Audio and hardware frame pacing unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual hold labels, map route and explicit assist accounting are helpful; threat cue handling and attention competition create friction.
reasons.readability: Large key controls and coil states read well; small signage, condensed prompts and muted enemies against gray structures are harder at 844x390.
